full_judgment: 5. 1.69 acre of land situated within Mouza Kakrail city of Dhaka, is the subject matter. Plaint case is that Oriental Development and Construction Ltd. acquired title to this land. In 1951 four persons Awlad Hossain Khan, Md. Fazlul Karim, Syed Abdul Hamid and Amina Khatun trespassed into this land, constructed some pucca and kutcha structures and thereby dispossessed the said owner who instituted Title Suit No.10 of 1952 in the 3rd. Court of Sub-Ordinate Judge, Dhaka, for khas possession on declaration of title against the said alleged trespassers.
